rule: Warm neutral RGB min>=200, range<43, r>=b-5,r>=g-5; outside clearly colored sibling bounds. Vertical strip: gap>8, w<2.5,h>8,h>6w. Far speck: gap>80, area<25,max dimension<8.
restoration: Reparent original nodes to parentId in ascending childIndex and reapply relativeTransform/visibility. Parent snapshots retained for validation; do not reset parent bounds by resizing groups.
